metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to release your upper back between the shoulder blades. 

TWO methods are shown that may help release back tightness and stiffness between the shoulder blades, resulting in a satisfying POP or CRACK.

They can be done at home or work, pretty much ANYPLACE and ANYTIME! That way you'll be able to release pressure in the back QUICKLY, and get the pop or crack you're looking for. 

Watch now and get feeling fast back relief!
